title: Efficiently Learning To Reason or Not to Reason: Root-token Policy Optimization for Adaptive Thinking
abstract: arXiv:2610.17767v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance by externalizing explicit reasoning traces before producing the answer, yet suffer from overthinking challenge that allocates uniformly heavy computation to queries of varying difficulty. While proprietary models mitigate this via opaque routing, open-source LRMs still lack an efficient mechanism to internalize adaptive reasoning due to both expensive training cost and limited disclosure of training recipes. In response, we introduce RPO (Root-token Policy Optimization), a framework that enables LRMs to self-determine when to reason by training only the initial root token (e.g., whether to invoke the  tag) via group relative reward and group-wise advantages. By focusing on this pivotal branching point, RPO drastically reduces training overhead and VRAM usage. translated_title: 高效学习“推理与否”：面向自适应思考的根词元策略优化
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型（LRM）通过在生成答案之前外化显式的推理轨迹而取得了强大的性能，但面临“过度思考”的挑战，即对不同难度的查询统一分配繁重的计算。虽然专有模型通过不透明的路由机制缓解了这一问题，但由于昂贵的训练成本以及训练方案披露有限，开源LRM仍然缺乏一种高效机制来内化自适应推理。为此，我们提出了RPO（根词元策略优化），这是一个使LRM能够自主决定何时进行推理的框架，其方法是通过组相对奖励和组级优势，仅训练初始根词元（例如，是否调用<think>标签）。通过聚焦于这一关键的分支点，RPO大幅降低了训练开销和显存占用。在多个模型家族和规模上，RPO仅用约2%的训练计算量就学会了难度感知的自适应思考。
tldr: 提出根词元策略优化（RPO），仅通过训练初始根词元来决定是否触发推理，使大型推理模型能以约2%的训练计算量学会难度自适应的思考，大幅降低训练开销与显存占用。
en_tdlr: RPO (Root-token Policy Optimization) trains only the initial root token to decide whether to invoke reasoning, enabling large reasoning models to learn difficulty-aware adaptive thinking with just ~2% of the training computation while drastically reducing training overhead and VRAM usage.
